name: @red-cup-engineering/cartridge
description: The game manifest schema and intent-log/replay contract every 561 Group game implements: seed in, deterministic engine, intent log out, replay to verify. No external npm dependencies; depends only on the house's browser-safe portable SHA-256 (cryptographic-computer-data-engineering-services-section/portable-sha256). Subpath exports: @red-cup-engineering/cartridge/manifest (hand-rolled CartridgeManifest validation), @red-cup-engineering/cartridge/intent-log (append-only intent log, JSON encode/decode), @red-cup-engineering/cartridge/replay (generic replay harness + stable-hash verification), @red-cup-engineering/cartridge/seed (daily-UTC seed derivation, injected clock).

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs src/fixtures/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
